checkpoints.notes: 5 concepts brainstormed and scored; Tether Sumo selected (elastic-tether local 2-player arcade), Comet Sweep as fallback. Orbit Duel AI-rival evolution and Cycle 1 follow-ups deferred as 'polish' candidates, not new-prototype work.

Single-file HTML5 canvas architecture at game/tether-sumo/index.html (Cycle 1's game/index.html untouched). Spring-tether physics, anti-stalemate outward drift, live test-hook getters (avoiding Cycle 1's snapshot-staleness bug), and a test plan that includes win-condition/restart e2e from the start.

Self-contained playable prototype: 2-player local elastic-tether sumo arcade game, no build step, no external assets/deps. Implements spring+damping tether force, anti-stalemate outward drift, round/match state machine (best of 3), live test-hook getters per design doc.

Automated Playwright/headless-Chromium tests: load+interaction smoke test, no-input soak test, and win-condition+restart e2e test, all PASS. Found and fixed a real anti-stalemate design bug during testing: constant outward drift force against the linear tether spring settled into a permanent near-center equilibrium and never resolved a round; fixed with idle-time-escalating drift (reset on any input). Fun/balance tuning still not human-playtested -- flagged as follow-up.

followUps: Human/manual playtest of Tether Sumo for feel/balance tuning (SHIP_THRUST, TETHER_K, TETHER_DAMPING, ARENA_DRIFT, IDLE_DRIFT_RAMP).
Automated test for the simultaneous-double-elimination tie-break edge case.

Cycle 1 follow-ups remain open and deferred: Orbit Duel manual playtest tuning, Orbit Duel win-condition e2e test, and a possible Orbit Duel AI-opponent mode -- good candidates for a future 'polish/iterate' cycle rather than a new-prototype cycle.
